'''Nezhel "Sunspot" Othren''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ace pilot during the [[Great Galactic War]]. In the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he commanded a [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]] squadron and during a [[Battle above Saleucami|skirmish]] over [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] he was shot down by a member of the elite [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Empire's Fury]] [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]] squadron.
